title: Painful Sex (Dyspareunia)
summary: Pain during sex isn't something to just push through. Common causes include not enough arousal or lube, tension, infections, skin conditions, endometriosis or vaginismus.
key_points: Persistent pain deserves a doctor's or gynaecologist's check.
